SA3 concordance table

One row per (model, ckpt) present in trajectory analysis, acoustic descriptors, and/or human votes -- joined on EXACT name match only, never guessed. A row with has_trajectory=False means that model/ckpt was voted on or scored but the trajectory sweep's run_name for it (if any) didn't match; a wandb-hash run_name (see build_concordance.py docstring) has no recipe name to join against at all and will never appear here under descriptors/votes. Vote columns are per axis (Kim rates "well produced" and "interesting" differently) -- win_X is the win-rate on axis X, n_X is how many pairwise votes fed it. Click a header to sort; type to filter.
